sourceNotes: Taken verbatim from this project's own existing, already-in-production Instagram renderer token file (instagram-post-automation/renderer/colors.json, 'Merkezi renk token dosyasi -- Asama 5.1. Renderer yalnizca bu dosyadan okur'), not re-derived. That file is treated as authoritative for Instagram-channel color, since it is the canonical source the project's own renderer already reads from for this exact purpose. A separate marketing-website brand doc (website/docs/05_BRAND_AND_DESIGN.md) states a visibly different palette (Turkiye Red #B30015, Warm White #F8F6F2, Soft Cream #EFE7DA, Charcoal #1A1A1A, Navy #0A1F44) for the website's own UI -- noted here as an observed discrepancy between the two sub-projects, not reconciled, since this Channel Pack is scoped to Instagram design and the renderer token file is the purpose-matched source.
